translate_en|mods/Gores Industrial Fluid: Maximum range used by registered tanker and trailer fluid-source adapters.
Makes large tank tiles and their connected cabinets resistant to damage, fire, pickup, rotation, and dismantling. Compact tanks remain normal destructible moveables.
Maximum distance from a tank or cabinet when starting a transfer.
One unit represents approximately 20 L of propane, 100 L of gasoline, or 50 L of clean water. Large tanks support propane, gasoline, and clean water.
For ordinary native liquids, one unit is 50 L (default 8 = 400 L). Propane uses approximately 20 L per unit through its separate adapter. Vanilla fluid rules control compatible liquids and mixtures.
translate_en|mods/Gores SVU4 Core/42/med: Set a separate bulb color for Front, Left, Right and Rear.
Applying a colored bulb consumes one matching bulb item. Warm White is the free default.
Percentage of incoming damage absorbed by Apocalypse armor. Higher values protect the vehicle more.
Multiplies added armor mass on vehicles.
Block SVU4 Armor on KI5 Vehicles
When enabled, Gore's SVU4 will not install armor on any detected KI5 / that DAMN Library vehicle. Use the vehicle's native armor system instead.
Logs armor installs, repairs, removals, rejected actions, and gas leak events to the server log.
Allows players to install Apocalypse armor. Existing Apocalypse armor can still be removed or repaired unless another compatibility rule blocks it.
Enables added vehicle weight from installed armor.
Allows old world vehicles to spawn with random worn armor panels already installed. Server-authoritative in multiplayer.
Allows players to install Reinforced armor. Existing Reinforced armor can still be removed or repaired unless another compatibility rule blocks it.
Allows players to install Scrap armor. Existing Scrap armor can still be removed or repaired unless another compatibility rule blocks it.
Enables MetalWelding and Mechanics requirements for armor grades.
Allows players to install Standard armor. Existing Standard armor can still be removed or repaired unless another compatibility rule blocks it.
Multiplies the fuel loss rate from punctured gas tank armor. Set to 0 to disable fuel leaking.
Gas Tank condition required to clear the leak after repairing the vanilla tank.
Condition damage applied to the vanilla Gas Tank when gas tank armor is destroyed.
Multiplies armor crafting and repair costs.
Limits how many armor actions a player can queue from one batch button press. This applies to batch install, batch repair, and batch remove. Single actions are unaffected.

Controls how players can queue armor installs. Single only disables batch installing. One grade allows batch installs but clears the selection when changing grade. Full multi-install allows mixed grades in one batch.
Chance each vehicle/panel roll can spawn worn Apocalypse armor. Keep this low for rare survivor builds.
Maximum health for randomly spawned survivor armor panels.

translate_en|mods/Gores Spare Engine Par: Old grade. Repair effectiveness: 70%% of Regular. Each part provides about 35 condition-equivalent repair instead of the normal 50. Requires Mechanics 6, Metalworking 4 and Electrical 4.
Performance grade. Repair effectiveness: 140%% of Regular. Each part provides about 70 condition-equivalent repair instead of the normal 50. Requires Mechanics 8, Metalworking 5 and Electrical 4.
Regular grade. Repair effectiveness: 100%% baseline. Each part provides the normal 50 condition-equivalent repair. Requires Mechanics 7, Metalworking 5 and Electrical 4.
